name: row-arrangements
title: Row arrangements
summary: Six labelled rows of three squares, one for each horizontalArrangement: start, center, end, spaceBetween, spaceEvenly and spaceAround.
prompt: Show how start, center, end, spaceBetween, spaceEvenly and spaceAround distribute three squares in a row, one labelled row each.
teaches: Distribute a row's children along its width with horizontalArrangement (start, center, end, spaceBetween, spaceEvenly, spaceAround)
Centre children across the row with verticalAlignment center
Give each demo track the remaining width with weight 1 after a fixed-width label (a text with a width modifier)

snippets.note: horizontalArrangement spaceBetween: first and last squares touch the ends
spaceEvenly: four equal gaps, ends included
spaceAround: half-size gaps at the ends

check.describe: In each 236 px track the squares sit left, centred, right, at both ends, with four equal gaps, and with half gaps at the ends. Resized (240, 540 wide) the label column keeps its width and each track takes the rest, so the arrangements spread over the wider tracks and pack tighter in the narrow ones.

pitfalls: Arrangement only shows when the row is wider than its children: give the row a width (here weight 1) or every value looks like start
In a row the main axis is horizontalArrangement and the cross axis verticalAlignment; the parser reads either spelling of each for the same field, so the name does not switch axes
